subject: Model accuracy - counterfeit detection
text:
Hi Joon,

Congrats on your Series B! I saw expanding your AI team is a key focus from
the fundraise, so I want to introduce myself as your point of contact at
Encord - a computer vision platform to streamline annotation/
human-in-the-loop workflows.

We’ve supported teams like GumGum, DoubleVerify, and Zefr, whom similar to
MarqVision train their models on large volume of social media /marketplace
images from the web. With Encord, they’ve increased annotation efficiency
by 60% and reduced model false positive rate from 6% to 1%.

We mainly help automating manual annotation with LLM/VLM so human experts
can focus on edge cases - e.g. when logos or trademarks are partially
obscured or contextually ambiguous. This reduces engineering overhead in
building custom tooling and accelerates model iteration cycles.

Would you be open to a quick chat to explore if we can help your team build
more accurate models? I'm flexible morning times PT.

Best,
Winnie

on the ground! Though I'd reach out since we've been working with Motive &
Automotus on similar fleet & road-facing CV models.

growing complexity of spatial + temporal data. We help by making
annotation of multimodal datasets (image, video, 3D etc) faster, more
accurate, and cost-efficient. That means better model performance in
safety critical use cases like navigation, driver safety, and curbside
logistics.

model evaluation into one place, so teams can focus on building better
models.
